results.title: Isamaa, EKRE and Center agree on new Pärnu coalition
results.description: Isamaa, EKRE and the Center Party have reached an agreement to form a new governing coalition in Pärnu, Pärnu City Council Chair Andrei Korobeinik said.

results.title: Mass resignation hits CINTAA: Why eight members quit the Poonam Dhillon-led actors body
results.description: CINTAA General Secretary Upasana Singh said that eight of the 11 executive committee members have accused Poonam Dhillon and Padmini Kolhapure of misusing their positions.
